answer: Each completed job mints one nontransferable receipt only after its requester signs the accepted output hash. At payout, enforcement replays a randomly selected receipt; a mismatch voids that claim and quarantines its linked batch. A ripple of same-time claims raises the audit rate. Agents may wander across tasks, while a public-seed draw works like pulling a marble from a jar to keep sampling unpredictable. Proposed one-time fee: 2 POA per identity; 2 POA × 1,000 fakes = 2,000 POA, versus 2 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: colluding requesters can still certify fabricated work.
